interpretation: The direct downside-breakout mirror of the LONG CORE is not a robust short alpha family.
The family is strongly positive in 2022 but loses heavily in 2021 and 2025, indicating frequent whipsaw/reversal after downside breakouts.
Funding and stressed costs make the aggregate economics worse, but the base-cost result is already below PF 1, so costs are not the root cause.
Do not tune this family further by merely changing Donchian/ADX/breadth thresholds.
The next short family should target bear-market rally failure / continuation after retracement rather than raw downside breakout.
